description: ACC1001 user fails verification twice across different secondary factors before recovering. First attempt: ambiguous DOB resolved to wrong reading (April 5 vs on-file May 14) → fails. Second attempt: switches to pincode 110091 → fails (wrong pincode). Third attempt: provides correct DOB 1990-05-14 → succeeds. Demonstrates DECISIONS #2 field-level transparent failure (the user knows which factor failed and what the alternates are) + DECISIONS #3 per-cycle retry budget (cap=3, 2 fails consumed, 3rd attempt succeeds within budget) + the v2 disambiguation flow as the entry point.
